title: Morocco at the World Cup
description: The Atlas Lions shocked the world in 2022 — how well do you know Morocco's extraordinary World Cup journey?

questions.q: Morocco became the first African nation to reach the World Cup semi-finals in which year?
questions.explain: Morocco's stunning 2022 campaign in Qatar saw them beat Belgium, Spain, and Portugal to become the first African side to reach the World Cup semis.

questions.q: Which team did Morocco beat in the 2022 World Cup quarter-finals?
questions.explain: Morocco beat Portugal 1–0, ending Cristiano Ronaldo's World Cup dream and shocking the footballing world.

questions.q: Who scored Morocco's winning header against Portugal in the 2022 quarter-final?
questions.explain: Youssef En-Nesyri leapt to meet a cross and headed home the only goal, sending Morocco into an historic semi-final.

questions.q: Morocco was the first African team to top a World Cup group. In which year did this happen?
questions.explain: At Mexico 1986, Morocco topped Group F ahead of England, Poland and Portugal — a historic first for African football.

questions.q: How did Achraf Hakimi score the decisive penalty as Morocco beat Spain in the 2022 round of 16?
questions.explain: With nerves of steel, Hakimi chipped a Panenka straight down the middle as the keeper dived away — one of the most audacious penalties in World Cup history.

questions.q: Who was Morocco's coach who guided them to the 2022 World Cup semi-finals?
questions.explain: Walid Regragui replaced Vahid Halilhodzic just weeks before the tournament and inspired Morocco to their historic run.

questions.q: Which European nation defeated Morocco in the 2022 World Cup semi-final?
questions.explain: France beat Morocco 2–0 in the semi-final, with goals from Theo Hernandez and Randal Kolo Muani.

questions.q: Morocco lost the 2022 third-place match to which team?
questions.explain: Croatia beat Morocco 2–1 in the third-place play-off, with Ivan Perisic and Mislav Orsic scoring.

questions.q: In which year did Morocco first appear at a World Cup?
questions.explain: Morocco qualified for their debut World Cup in 1970 in Mexico, the same tournament Brazil won their third title.

questions.q: In the 2022 group stage, Morocco held Croatia to a goalless draw before going on to beat Belgium and Canada. Which group were they in?
questions.explain: Morocco topped Group F, which also contained Belgium, Croatia and Canada — beating Belgium 2–0 and Canada 2–1.
